decision.reasoning_trace: The search results were heavily cluttered with non-speaker items such as AC adapters, replacement batteries, carrying cases, and handle straps, which made the browsing experience frustrating. While there were a few strong candidates like the JBL Clip 3 and the INSMY speaker, the JBL was only available in Dusty Pink and the JBL Flip 5 was a renewed unit with mixed reviews regarding battery longevity. Given the high percentage of irrelevant accessory results and limited variety in new, name-brand portable speakers in standard colors, I decided to defer my purchase.
